name: dl_uart_tx_source
description: Stream0 UART complete payload staging and one-message credit reservation over an external exclusive-consumer FIFO.

design_requirements.confirmation_notes: User authorized full local RTL implementation and independent self-review. This bounded native internal interface is an implementation choice under that scope, not a user-specified wire layout.

behavior: One reserved stream0 message; payload count=min(pre-edge modulo4096 credits, external FIFO fill,32). New credit on the same edge is usable next cycle.

Capture1..32 complete payload DWORDs with FIFO ready/valid; pending remains false until all reserved words are actually staged. External FIFO has one consumer and its occupancy includes cached/in-flight read words.

Fixed stream0 header=(payload_count-1)<<27 |4; total count includes header. First source take consumes header but no payload storage/credit. Final payload take adds captured payload count modulo4096 to TX counter.
No second reservation while busy. Header/count/current payload remain stable across downstream stalls; later credit/fill changes do not alter the message.

Staged occupancy includes actual buffered unsent payload only. Wrapper must combine it with external FIFO occupancy to enforce total firmware TX capacity; source has32 staging registers, no additional128-word firmware FIFO.

Channel4 disable gates FIFO consumption and source pending. After a header was taken, disabling raises a local integration fault and preserves remaining state. Legal offline negotiation must drain first; restore resumes. Coordinated reset with FIFO and arbiter is required for abort.
Invalid take never consumes or retires words and raises a local error. Independent reservation/staging/credit-update events still proceed. No wire error code assigned.
Synchronous active-low local reset clears state and suppresses exposed signals combinationally. It does not implement40NoOp/10ms Stream Reset.
Decoded credit validity/stream eligibility is upstream. Four-transmitted-flit Credit Update cadence UCR01 remains unresolved; no speculative cadence implementation in this source.
constraints: Verilog2001, same-line Chinese comments, one register per sequential always, no functions/tasks/raw clocks.
Single clock;640/6400ps simulation periods are characterization inputs, not timing closure or PHY throughput.
notes: Contract details and open cadence point in docs/uart_tx_source_plan.md.
